moves.name: Bleakwind Storm
moves.description: Never misses when the weather is rainy. Has a chance (30%) of lowering the target’s Speed by 1 stat rank.

moves.name: Fly
moves.description: The user begins flying. After a set time, the user stops flying and attacks. No other actions can be taken while flying. Most moves used by opponents will not hit the user while it is flying. If the user is hit by a sync move or max move while flying, it will stop flying.

passives.name: Unova Spirit
passives.description: Powers up the special attack moves of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits ]%. Reduces special attack move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits Idx="1" ]%. The more allied sync pairs with [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves by [Digit:2digits Idx="3" ]% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is [Digit:2digits Idx="4" ]%, and the maximum damage reduction is [Digit:2digits Idx="5" ]%.)

passives.name: Season-Turning Power
passives.description: The user’s moves never miss. Raises the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ] when it enters a battle. Except in certain circumstances, successful hits with the user’s following attacks become critical hits: Pokémon’s moves or sync move.

passives.name: New Teacher’s Quick Wit
passives.description: Increases the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect by [Digit:1digit ] [EN:Qty S="rank" P="ranks" ] when its attack move is successful. The more the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="1" ] is increased, the more it powers up its moves. The more the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="1" ] is increased, the more it powers up its sync move.

passives.description: Increases the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect by [Digit:1digit ] [EN:Qty S="rank" P="ranks" ] after using its sync move.
